meta_title: Special Branch | Tree & Garden Services Birmingham
meta_description: Special Branch Tree and Garden Services in Birmingham. Expert tree surgery, garden maintenance and removal. Trusted local arborists. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Certified Arborists — Safe, Professional Tree Work
hero_subhead: Dangerous limbs, overgrown gardens, or unwanted trees? We handle it safely and leave your garden transformed.
services_heading: Complete Tree and Garden Services Across Birmingham
services_subhead: From emergency storm damage to routine garden maintenance, we handle every aspect of arboricultural care with certified expertise.

services.title: Emergency Tree Removal
services.desc: Storm damage, fallen trees, or hazardous limbs threatening your home? We respond quickly to make the area safe and clear debris.

services.title: Tree Surgery & Pruning
services.desc: Crown reduction, deadwood removal, and selective pruning to restore health and shape. We follow BS 3998 best practice standards.

services.title: Tree Stump Grinding
services.desc: Complete stump removal using professional grinding equipment. Clears the roots and allows you to replant or reclaim your garden space.

services.title: Garden Clearance
services.desc: Overgrown borders, dense undergrowth, or abandoned gardens cleared safely. We handle disposal and leave a blank canvas to work with.

services.title: Hedge Trimming & Maintenance
services.desc: Regular hedge cutting keeps boundaries tidy and promotes healthy new growth. We work to your preferred height and shape.

services.title: Tree Reports & Surveys
services.desc: Professional condition assessments for surveying purposes, insurance claims, or peace of mind. Detailed written reports provided.

about_pullquote: We treat every tree like it belongs to our own family—with care and respect.
about_para_1: Special Branch was founded on the principle that good arboriculture isn't just about cutting wood—it's about understanding the tree, the site, and the customer's needs. Over 18 years, we've built a reputation for safe, honest, professional work across Birmingham and the Black Country. Every member of our team is trained to the highest standards and carries the knowledge to handle everything from routine maintenance to complex removals.
about_para_2: We're known locally for turning up on time, explaining the job clearly, and leaving gardens cleaner than we found them. Repeat customers make up over 70% of our work because they know we won't overcomplicate or oversell. Word of mouth has always been our best advert—and that's how we like it.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a massive oak that was leaning towards the house. Got a quote from Special Branch and they explained exactly what needed doing and why. Job was done in a day, all waste cleared, and the garden looked bigger. Really professional outfit. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Emergency callout after the storm. They were here within 24 hours, made the area safe, and got rid of the fallen tree. Fair price and no messing about. Dealing with them again for general garden work next month.
reviews.author: Eleanor T.

reviews.text: Overgrown hedge was getting out of hand. They pruned it properly—not just hacked at it—and it's come back thick and neat. They turned up when they said, cleaned up after themselves. That's rare these days. Highly impressed.
reviews.author: Marcus R.
